newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan one-month NCD single yield at 5.100 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan one-month NCD single yield at 5.100 pct.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank issued T$5 billion in one-month negotiable certificates of deposit on Thursday at a single yield of 5.100 percent, a central bank official said.
Demand for the one-month NCDs totalled T$8.5 billion.
The bank also issued T$3 billion in 14-day NCDs at a single yield of 5.001 percent, the official said. Demand for the 14-day NCDs totalled T$7 billion.

During a sustained stock rally in March and April, the central bank repeatedly issued NCDs, a move widely seen as aiming to keep a lid on the loose liquidity that many experts said had been fuelling what then was a sizzling stock market.
The central bank has confirmed that it was responding to the liquidity sitution but denied that it was acting directly in response to the stock market bull run.
The stock market in recent week has entered a consolidation, with daily turnover plunging to less than half of of the record levels set during the big rally.
